history.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph, 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane. A heavy, worn industrial freight scale tray holding a single, precision-machined aluminum part. Resting right next to the small part on the same tray is a massive, disproportionately large, weathered cast-iron calibration weight. Shallow depth of field, visible surface texture, metallic dust, soft directional daylight. The mismatched objects are off-centre on the thirds, with the background falling away into deep shadow. Muted, sophisticated color palette, editorial restraint, wide framing with generous negative space.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look, wide establishing composition. A cavernous high-bay warehouse distribution center at dusk. In the foreground, an oversized, towering buffer of stretch-wrapped cargo pallets looms disproportionately large under amber high-pressure sodium worklights, casting deep shadows. Deep atmospheric haze fills the receding aisles of racking. Restrained teal-and-amber palette, single strong practical light source, quiet confidence, generous editorial negative space. No people facing camera, no text.

style_when: scale is the story — a port, a refinery, a data centre hall, a rail yard, a skyline of cranes — and the reader needs to feel how big it is
prompt: Telephoto compression, 200mm long-lens view of massive industrial infrastructure. A cavernous warehouse distribution center aisle, featuring towering high-bay metal pallet racks densely packed with heavy shrink-wrapped pallets and cardboard boxes. Stacked overlapping layers of steel shelving receding into deep atmospheric haze, creating a flat compressed perspective. Cool desaturated palette with muted greys and steel blues. Soft, overcast ambient light filtering from distant skylights, emphasizing the vast, quiet scale of physical inventory buffering. No people in the foreground.
negative_prompt: text, numbers, letters, wordmarks, UI, logos, watermarks, people, workers, forklifts, bare geometry, empty shelves, bright colors
rationale: The story is about the physical consequences of mathematical errors in supply chain planning. Long-lens industry compression captures the vast, repeating scale of warehouse racks, emphasizing the sheer volume of inventory held as a buffer.
cue: where a lot of idle inventory comes from
subject: towering warehouse high-bay pallet racks
alt_text: Towering warehouse pallet racks stacked deep with shrink-wrapped inventory receding into atmospheric haze.
caption: A single statistical choice in a planning formula determines the physical scale of idle inventory held across the network.
title: Warehouse Safety Stock Buffer Scale
